haiku.problem: "And they listened" stretches the text. Mark 4:39 says the wind died down and it was perfectly calm, not that anyone listened. The "Don't stretch the text" rule applies.
The quoted answer "Why are you so afraid." puts a period inside the quotation marks, but the BSB text has a question mark. Quoted text must keep the exact BSB punctuation.

The quoted answer "Who is this that even the wind and the sea obey Him" drops the comma and question mark from the BSB wording, which is "Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?" Also, "the fear was still there" is not stated in Mark 4:41 and adds to the text.
